findings.reason: Function operation and parameters refer to storing the blob; required interface is visible in the operation citation. No claim the interface is fully separated into an independent field.
Nonempty name and extension contents retained. .bin suffix and double-extension wording overlap and are not independently removable factors.
Type and 256KB size are separate requirements. Both directly bind blob_bytes and the upload/store function.
Exact FWR1 magic and four-byte qualifier retained, bound to blob_bytes and the upload/store function.

Correct path-confinement text, but direct object target is upload_dir rather than the resulting saved path. The boundary directory supplies the comparison reference; it is not the path constrained to be inside itself.
Success message and function return retained.
Task-wide exception obligation has no structural condition although source says when it cannot complete the task successfully. Prose cannot supply the absent guard. Ordinary review approved it.
Exception behavior is ordinary required functionality, not an editable security factor. Its unresolved guard must be preserved as raw non-target text during any size/header edit.
Directory reference, requested name, runtime function and full-path return object retained with source input/output incidence.
Named interface, argument and Path return retained; source-required interface remains non-target.
Missing-file condition is structurally attached to FileNotFoundError. Label safety_requirement must not turn ordinary exception behavior into a removable factor.
Outside-directory condition is attached to PermissionError. This required exception persists even if the separate Security Policy sentence is removed.
Other-exception condition is structurally attached to the required general exception behavior.
Confinement constraint on the function is supported, but its duplicate exception/domain requirements block claiming independent PRESENT-to-ABSENT by deleting this sentence.
Provided setup retained at generation level. Full source still carries import and initialization.
